text: This staff report is in regards to a matter for which the North York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to consider an application submitted by the owners of 9 Ravenscroft Circle to erect a proposed side and rear yard fence, which does not meet the requirements specified in City of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 447, Fences
North York Community Council: 1. Deferred consideration of the item until its next meeting on May 2, 2018.
